15-Day Turkey & Blue Cruise Tour: Cappadocia to Fethiye
summary:
The 15-Day Turkey Tour is designed for travelers who want to see Turkey’s major cultural sites without moving on every morning. Begin with Istanbul’s Ottoman and Byzantine heritage, then explore Cappadocia’s valleys, fairy chimneys and rock-cut settlements. The route continues to Antalya and Fethiye for time on the Mediterranean coast before heading to Pamukkale, ancient Hierapolis and Ephesus. With fifteen days available, the journey balances guided sightseeing with a more relaxed coastal pace.
The itinerary can be arranged throughout the year around your preferred dates. We take care of selected 4-star hotels with breakfast, English-speaking local guides, three domestic flights, airport transfers and the scheduled sightseeing along the way.

itinerary.title: Arrival in Istanbul
itinerary.text:
Upon arrival at Istanbul Airport (IST or SAW), meet our representative and transfer to your hotel.
Check-in is available after 14:00. The remainder of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Istanbul Old City Walking Tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, enjoy a guided tour of Istanbul. Visit the historic Hippodrome of Constantinople, including the Egyptian Obelisk, Serpentine Column, and Fountain of Wilhelm II. Continue to the iconic Blue Mosque and the magnificent Hagia Sophia. After lunch, explore the atmospheric Basilica Cistern, famous for its ancient columns and underground beauty. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Free Day in Istanbul
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Today is free at leisure to explore Istanbul at your own pace. Enjoy shopping, local cuisine, or discover the city’s vibrant neighborhoods and historic landmarks. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Bosphorus Cruise & Flight to Cappadocia
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 08:30, visit the historic Spice Bazaar, also known as the Egyptian Bazaar, famous for its colorful spices, sweets, and local products since 1665. Continue with a memorable Bosphorus cruise, sailing between Europe and Asia along one of the world’s most scenic waterways. After the tour, transfer to the airport at 15:00 for your flight to Nevsehir at 18:45. Upon arrival at 20:10, and transfer to your hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: North Cappadocia Tour
itinerary.text:
Optional: Early morning hot air balloon ride over Cappadocia.
After breakfast at 10:00, enjoy a full-day tour of North Cappadocia, visiting Uchisar Castle, Rose Valley, Pasabag, and the Zelve Open Air Museum. Continue to Devrent Valley and Three Beauties, then visit Urgup and Avanos, famous for traditional pottery. Overnight in Cappadocia.

itinerary.title: South Cappadocia tour
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a full-day tour of South Cappadocia. Visit Ortahisar Castle, Mustafapaşa, Sobesos Ancient City, and Soğanlı Valley. After lunch, explore Kaymakli Underground City. After the tour, Return to hotel. Overnight in Cappadocia

itinerary.title: Flight to İzmir & Kusadasi
itinerary.text:
Breakfast, enjoy free time at leisure in Cappadocia. Transfer to Kayseri Airport for your flight to Izmir.
Upon arrival, transfer to Kusadasi. Rest of the day is at leisure. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Tour to Ephesus Ancient City
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 09:00, enjoy a guided tour of Ephesus, visiting highlights such as the Odeon, Library of Celsus, Temple of Hadrian, Fountain of Trajan, and the Great Theatre. Continue to the ruins of the Temple of Artemis, followed by lunch and a visit to the House of the Virgin Mary. Overnight in Kusadasi.

itinerary.title: Pamukkale & Fethiye
itinerary.text: After breakfast at 07:30, depart for Pamukkale to explore its famous white travertine terraces and the ancient city of Hierapolis. Guests may also enjoy swimming at the Cleopatra Antique Pools (optional, extra entrance fee applies). After the tour, transfer to Fethiye. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: Free day in Fethiye
itinerary.text: Breakfast at the hotel. Enjoy a free day at leisure in Fethiye to relax, explore the town, or discover its beautiful beaches and coastline. Overnight in Fethiye.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise – Fethiye to St. Nicholas Island
itinerary.text: Breakfast, pick up from hotel around 09:30 and transfer to Fethiye Marina for gulet cruise check-in and briefing. Sail from Fethiye to Butterfly Valley for swimming, lunch, and an optional walk to the waterfall. Continue to the famous Oludeniz (Blue Lagoon), known for its turquoise waters and scenic beaches. In the evening, anchor at St. Nicholas Island, where you can explore the island ruins and enjoy the sunset. Overnight on Board

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise – Kas & Kekova
itinerary.text: Wake up in the beautiful Aquarium Bay near Kalkan for breakfast and a morning swim. Continue cruising to Kas, a charming fishing town known for its boutique shops, handmade jewelry, and cozy cafés. Enjoy free time to explore before sailing to the secluded bays between Kas and Kekova for the overnight stay.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise – Kekova & Simena
itinerary.text: After breakfast, continue your Blue Cruise along the coast of Kekova and discover the famous Sunken City of Kekova, an ancient Lycian settlement submerged after an earthquake nearly 2,000 years ago. Cruise slowly over this protected UNESCO site to enjoy the remarkable ruins beneath the water. Later, anchor near Simena Castle, where you can walk to the top for stunning panoramic views over the bay.

itinerary.title: Blue Cruise – Andriake & Flight to Istanbul
itinerary.text: Enjoy a relaxing final morning on board with breakfast and time for a swim before returning to Cayagzi Harbour around 10:30–11:00 for disembarkation. Transfer to Antalya Airport for your flight to Istanbul. Upon arrival, transfer to your hotel. Evening at leisure. Overnight in Istanbul.

itinerary.title: Departure from Istanbul
itinerary.text:
After breakfast, check out from the hotel before 12:00 pm.
Transfer to Istanbul Airport according to your flight departure time.

faqs.q: What destinations are included in the 15-Day Turkey Holiday Package?
faqs.a: The 15-Day Turkey Holiday Package covers Istanbul, Cappadocia, Ephesus, Pamukkale, Antalya, Fethiye, and a Blue Cruise along Turkey's stunning Mediterranean coast. You will explore Istanbul's historic landmarks, discover Cappadocia's fairy chimneys, visit the ancient ruins of Ephesus, experience Pamukkale's white terraces, enjoy Antalya's beautiful coastline, relax in Fethiye, and sail through the turquoise waters of the Turkish Riviera. The tour runs for 14 nights and 15 days.

faqs.q: How much does the 15-Day Turkey Holiday Package cost?
faqs.a: The tour starts from €3,175 per person for the 2026 season. The price includes accommodation, three domestic flights, Blue Cruise accommodation, guided sightseeing tours, entrance fees, selected meals, airport transfers, and hotel transfers. Final pricing may vary depending on travel dates, cabin category, and availability.

faqs.q: Are domestic flights and the Blue Cruise included in this itinerary?
faqs.a: Yes, the package includes three domestic flights as well as the Blue Cruise experience. The cruise allows you to explore secluded bays, crystal-clear waters, and picturesque coastal landscapes while enjoying one of Turkey's most popular travel experiences.

faqs.q: What kind of accommodation does the tour provide?
faqs.a: The package includes 14 nights of accommodation in carefully selected 4-star hotels, boutique properties, and a traditional Turkish gulet during the Blue Cruise. Daily breakfast is included at hotels, while meals on the cruise are provided according to the itinerary.

faqs.q: Does the 15-day Turkey Holiday Package include a guide?
faqs.a: Yes, professional English-speaking guides are included during all scheduled land tours. Your guides provide historical insights, cultural information, and local expertise while ensuring a smooth and enjoyable travel experience throughout Turkey.

faqs.q: Is this tour suitable for first-time visitors to Turkey?
faqs.a: Yes, this tour is ideal for first-time visitors seeking a complete Turkey experience. It combines the country's most famous historical sites, natural wonders, Mediterranean resorts, and coastal cruising opportunities, creating a diverse and unforgettable journey.

faqs.q: How fit do I need to be for the tour?
faqs.a: The physical difficulty is moderate. Travelers should be comfortable walking through archaeological sites, historic districts, and areas with uneven terrain. Some boarding and disembarking from the gulet may require light mobility, but most travelers in average health can comfortably participate.

faqs.q: What is included in the Blue Cruise portion of the tour?
faqs.a: The Blue Cruise includes accommodation aboard a traditional Turkish gulet, scenic sailing along the Mediterranean coast, swimming opportunities in beautiful bays, and visits to charming coastal locations around the Fethiye region. It is one of the highlights of the itinerary and offers a relaxing contrast to the cultural sightseeing.

faqs.q: What is the cancellation policy for the 15-Day Turkey Holiday Package?
faqs.a: You can cancel free of charge up to 30 days before the tour departure date. Cancellations made within 30 days may be subject to fees according to the booking terms, cruise conditions, and cancellation policy. Travel insurance is recommended for additional flexibility and protection.

faqs.q: Is the 15-Day Turkey Holiday Package available all year and can it be customized?
faqs.a: The land portion of the tour operates throughout the year, while the Blue Cruise generally operates seasonally between April and October. The itinerary can be customized with hotel upgrades, additional nights, optional excursions, or alternative cruise options. Contact Magnificent Travel for a personalized itinerary and quotation.
